observation.1: {graha} aapke pehle bhaav mein hain — jin dinon aap nishchit nahin hotin, un dinon bhi aapko nishchit hi samjha jaata hai, hai na?
observation.2: {graha} aapke doosre bhaav mein hain — aap suraksha ko usi se naapti hain jo aapne bachakar rakha hai, hai na?
observation.3: {graha} aapke teesre bhaav mein hain — aap khud ko himmat wali baat ke liye mana leti hain, aur phir kar bhi deti hain.
observation.4: {graha} aapke chauthe bhaav mein hain — ghar wahi jagah hai jahan aap phir se apni ho jaati hain.
observation.5: {graha} aapke paanchvein bhaav mein hain — aap kuchh rachti hain, aur yeh bhi maayne rakhta hai ki woh dekha jaaye, chahe aap kahein na.
observation.6: {graha} aapke chhathe bhaav mein hain — jo sab taal dete hain, woh aap sambhaal leti hain, hai na?
observation.7: {graha} aapke saatvein bhaav mein hain — aap apne se pehle saamne wale ka man padh leti hain.
observation.8: {graha} aapke aathvein bhaav mein hain — kathin sach chhipaye jaane se behtar aapko jaan lena lagta hai.
observation.9: {graha} aapke nauvein bhaav mein hain — aap har baat ke peeche ka bada kaaran dhoondhti rehti hain.
observation.10: {graha} aapke dasvein bhaav mein hain — saksham dikhna aapke liye usse zyada maayne rakhta hai jitna aap kehti hain.
observation.11: {graha} aapke gyaarahvein bhaav mein hain — aap apnon ki ummeedein apni ummeedon ke saath uthaye chalti hain.
observation.12: {graha} aapke baarahvein bhaav mein hain — aapko ek aisa kona chahiye jahan koi pahunch na sake.
